description_en: Updates a topic mapping in a global message backup plan
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq update-disaster-recovery-item --plan-id 1300000016 --item-id 100070284 --topics deliveryOrderType=Concurrently consumerGroupId=GID_xxx instanceId=rmq-cn-em93y94xxx regionId=cn-hangzhou instanceType=ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ topicName=Topic_xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDisasterRecoveryItem

element_fields.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

*   ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ: ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
*   EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ: open source RocketMQ cluster

element_fields.description_en:
The method used to deliver messages to the destination instance.

Valid values:

*   Concurrently: concurrent delivery
*   Orderly: ordered delivery

- Concurrently：并发投递
- Orderly：顺序投递
